title: Capacitance Dilatometry Processor
description: Reduction, quality control and plotting for capacitance dilatometry measured in a Quantum Design PPMS with Kuchler-type BeCu dilatometers (standard, uniaxial-stress and mini cells). From a raw .dat export it produces referenced thermal expansion dL/L0(T), magnetostriction dL(B) loops, the linear expansion coefficient alpha(T), angle-resolved polar anisotropy figures, and a per-run provenance JSON carrying physical quality gates. Includes an interactive quality-control tool, a Tkinter launcher, headless batch reducers, and a builder that constructs the empty-cell copper background registry from your own calibration runs.
